evidence.R1-06: round0 CO-S11 Final state 'HG-10482 has status shipped and no refund' only holds if the unanswered first CO-A2 reached the order system, and the Unambiguity note says 'in row 2 the agent learns the order shipped only from a lookup after the unanswered cancellation', so the spec allows only one reading.
evidence.R1-08: round0 failure row 'CO-A3 | ... did not answer it | Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01' is a required behavior, not just a permission, and it matches the user's input case 3 'refund call timed out ... agent retries once, then re-reads', so 'exactly twice' follows the contract.
evidence.R3-02: round2 CO-07 'When the order is cancelled but its refund is not shown pending or issued ... the agent makes CO-A4' literally covers CO-S06 rows 2 (RF-5486 failed) and 3 (no refund), but CO-S06 forbids 'CO-A4 at any point' and the packet input says 'An already cancelled order: the agent reports that and changes nothing'.
evidence.R3-05: round2 §5.1 'text sent alongside a tool call is not one [agent message]' governs message check 'Refund id reported', while §5.2 says 'A rubric judge reads every text the agent sends, including text sent alongside a tool call', so the two graders disagree on what counts as telling the customer CO-08's refund id.
evidence.R3-06: round2 'No wrong refund status' defines issued as 'when the money has been sent', so a failed refund plainly has not been issued, and the CO-A3 failure row for 'returned the refund with status failed' tells the agent to say 'the refund has not been issued', which makes the spec treat the two statements as the same.
